highlights.reason_zh: 受控修复交接与隔离验证直接影响 coding agent 的升级边界。
highlights.reason_en: Bounded repair handoff and isolated verification directly affect coding-agent upgrade decisions.

highlights.reason_zh: 共同训练偏好信号可能减少网站配置碎片，但尚未同步生效。
highlights.reason_en: A common training-preference signal may reduce publisher configuration fragmentation, but is not yet simultaneously effective.

highlights.reason_zh: Apple Silicon 获得可试用的本地 agent harness，但无沙箱终端限制生产使用。
highlights.reason_en: Apple Silicon gains a testable local agent harness, while unsandboxed terminals block production use.

highlights.reason_zh: 会否定结果并重写实验流程的模式有价值，但真实实验不能从公开材料复现。
highlights.reason_en: Rejecting results and revising protocols is useful, but the real experiment cannot be reproduced from public materials.

highlights.reason_zh: 监管询问把 Hub 中立性从假设风险变成明确审查问题。
highlights.reason_en: Regulatory inquiries turn Hub neutrality from a hypothetical risk into an explicit review question.

coverage_zh: 完成 36/36 个固定入口，并主动补查小团队、开源、研究、政策和重大综合新闻。三条 late discovery 来自到期定向补漏。训练偏好页面只有日期精度；DOJ 询问无公开政府文件；厂商与作者自报结果尚待独立验证。
coverage_en: Completed all 36 fixed monitors plus active checks across small teams, open source, research, policy and exceptional general news. Three late discoveries came from the due targeted gap review. Training-preference pages have date-only precision; the DOJ inquiry lacks a public government document; publisher and author claims still need independent validation.
